title: Lullaby Data
description:
Dive into the thrilling world of ECHO and LULLABY, where surviving the corporations, gangs and mads gods is a daily struggle.

FEATURES:

Visit the city, its inhabitants and activities

Infiltration and Hacking: 

Unlock doors, manipulate cameras, hack vending machines, and cybernetic implants to gain the upper hand.

Strategy and Stealth: 

Utilize stealth, silence, and hacking attacks to outsmart your enemies.

Travel and Exploration: 

Drive to various destinations such as the town of Cynapse, the EdenSynth farm, and the wastelands.

 

Character Customization: 

Modify your character's appearance with different clothes, hairstyles, and hats.

Weapons and Companions: 

Wield over 40 weapons, and benefit from the help of 4 passive pets and 4 pets capable of casting 12 different spells (and more)

bullet hell lite: 

As you advance in the game you will unlock multiple ways to rain bullets and spells on waves of enemies!! Survive!!

Prepare to immerse yourself in an epic adventure and every enemy can be outmaneuvered with your hacking and strategic skills. The fate of ECHO and LULLABY is in your hands.

Thanks to Gamemaker community for help <3
description_short: Follow the story of Lullaby and Echo in a futuristic world. Mixing action and adventure, meet many unusual characters, play numerous mini games, and explore space to discover the secrets of Lullaby and the mad gods.
